figures.caption: Table 1: Experimental results on offline EQS-Benchmark. We compare our Cold-EQS with strong baselines that satisfy the RT requirements. Each experiment was repeated 3 times; mean ± std reported.

Figure 2: Overview of our Cold-EQS framework. It contains four key components: (1) Supervised fine-tuning with clicked queries for warm-up; (2) Reinforcement learning with quality-aware rewards; (3) Uncertainty-aware sampling from online queries in the absence of click signals; (4) A iteration RL training strategy for continuous optimization.

Figure 1: Example of an AI shopping assistant where query suggestions are presented as clickable elements. We provide several example queries illustrating poor informativeness, low answerability, or hallucinations.
